what: Several rows of lettered pattern bands: the first row straight, then tilted alternately −10° and +14°, layered. Odd and even rows flow in opposite directions 400px each on a 20s linear loop — laid over a color panel so words like ”Work Archive” flow in a staggered way behind the center content (screen capture · button). Includes the original’s quirk that the distance doesn’t match the pattern tile (212px), so it jumps once per loop

options.tilt: List of tilt angles (°) used in rotation starting from the second line, default ”-10 14”
options.first: First-line tilt (°) — if given, only the first line uses this value and tilt applies from the second line, if not given, tilt applies from the first line
options.h: Band height (px), default 89 — also settable via --fx-h in css
options.[data-fx-part=band]: One band row (multiple). Its first child is one pattern cell, and the part repeats it across the band width

use: ● Work Archive● Work Archive

from.where: index.html .archive__bands (nine bands behind the blue archive section) — the original .archive-bg height 89px·width 200%, first row 0° then alternating −10°/14°, pattern marquee.svg 212px moved via background-position bg-left 400→0·bg-right 0→400, 20s linear infinite
